newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Wednesday's interbank session weaker against hard currencies on the back of slight import pressure.
"We had a few import orders. I saw one big payment going out and I think that's what moved the (exchange) rates," one foreign exchange dealer said.
"But I'm sure some money is still in the market, only most people are trying to protect their positions and square up for the year-end," he added.
The Zimbabwe unit finished the day at 10.7800/8000 against the U.S. dollar, down from 10.7625/7825 at Tuesday's close, and was also easier against sterling at 18.0370/0810 compared to 17.9217/9658.
It was at 6.9440/9600 from 6.9480/9641 against the mark, and at 2.3000/3070 versus South Africa's rand, down from 2.2742/2808 overnight.
